'''Shoufeng''' is an NPC in {{Location|Hongzhen}}.

==Location==
Shoufeng is located on the second story of Hongzhen.

==Quests and Events==
{{Quests and Events}}

==Dialogue==
{{Dialogue Start}}
:'''Shoufeng''' What are you doing here, {{Rover}}?
:'''Shoufeng''' Did you come back to visit or see Lady [[Xinyi]]?
:{{DIcon}} And you are...?
::'''Shoufeng''' Well, we met each other briefly in the secret chamber during the Temporal Disruption, though we never got to talk much.
::'''Shoufeng''' But I remember you very well, hero of Hongzhen.
:{{DIcon}} I know you, you are Shoufeng.
::'''Shoufeng''' I knew you'd recognize me!
::{{DIcon}} What have you been up to lately?
:'''Shoufeng''' Standing guard, working my shift... The usual.
:'''Shoufeng''' Of course, that used to be my and [[Bing'ge|Bingge's]] duty, but now that the [[Midnight Rangers]] are here, I'm not needed as much.
:{{DIcon}} You know Mt. Firmament better than the Midnight Rangers.
::'''Shoufeng''' Well, I'm a local, after all, so of course I know more than the rangers. Lady Xinyi sent me and Bingge to assist them probably for the same reason.
::'''Shoufeng''' But I'm not the talker Bingge is. The rangers are all right, but we just can't seem to find any common interest. 
:{{DIcon}} The arrival of Midnight Rangers should make things easier for you.
::'''Shoufeng''' That should be the case, but I'm not the talker Bingge is. The rangers are all right, but we just can't seem to find any common interest.
:'''Shoufeng''' In Bingge's words, it's a style clash... and that frustrates me.
:{{DIcon}} Embrace the differences and stay true to your own style.
:{{DIcon}} Just take it easy, they'll understand.
:'''Shoufeng''' You're right. I'm a country bumpkin and don't know much, but I know the ancestors came here from all over because of the due to TD Outbreak, yet they all got along in the end.
:'''Shoufeng''' Maybe Bingge did hit it on the nail. You can't rush friendship.
{{Dialogue End}}
